gen-almendra-display-fs-nunito: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display leads with a tall x-height and letters that never pinch shut. Nunito follows with rounded sans bowls and open terminals, so a long page of text goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sono: Sono keeps its lowercase tall and its spacing wide. Gugi's heading has cut-open terminals and curves that match its stems, and under it the sans-serif text moves along in a loose, unhurried stride.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-stack-sans-notch: Metamorphous carries large sidebearings, a high midline and a soft swell between fat and slim strokes, which gives the heading its commanding air. Stack Sans Notch reads in rod-straight lines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-stack-sans-headline: Wide-set and unbroken, with curves that stay open. Offside sets the tone up top, while Stack Sans Headline holds its monoline strokes crisp underneath, its deep middle band keeping small text legible.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads with distinct open gaps in c, e, s and a, and a marker-like line. Oxanium brings a high x-height and monoline strokes above it, so lowercase looks big in both fonts.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-stack-sans-text: Expressive from the first line, Paprika scatters its letters apart and lets lowercase fill the line like capitals. Stack Sans Text holds that energy in check with a constant marker-like line and curve endings kept well apart.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ubuntu-sans: Revalia's open-curved g and relaxed, widely separated stride stand out. Ubuntu Sans answers with single-width strokes like bent copper pipe and big lowercase eyes, which keeps the sans-serif text feeling like sign-shop vinyl.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans looks sharp and refined, with generous space between its curve ends and the stem. Bespoke Sans stays unhurried over a longer page, while Warnes' tapered ink strokes sit apart, bold and spacious.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-abeezee: Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they touch, spread across stretched, spacious tracking. ABeeZee follows with a neon-tube thickness and a high mean line, so the sans text feels friendly beside it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads clean, with wide open c terminals and a tall body with short stems. Alexandria's strongest quality is that it sits quiet beside Warnes, whose o has equally thick sides and top.
